published: commercial title string 46 mm x 42 mm x 100 mm
three-bolt manifold set with two pieces
raw aluminium finish, alloy not disclosed
hypotheses: 46 mm interpreted as upper flow diameter
42 mm interpreted as lower flow diameter
100 mm interpreted as axial runner height
three runners per bank on synthetic center positions
2 mm walls and two 6 mm common flanges
side runners splayed 10 mm outward and 5 mm laterally
geometry_authority.not_claimed: No PMO or Porsche surface, port spacing, bolt pattern, flange, fitment or flow performance is claimed.

synthetic_cases.authority: regression inputs only; no measured M64 volumetric efficiency, pulse, temperature, port field or complete intake tract

material_screen.scope: generic ambient screening values; no qualified intake-manifold LPBF material card

dfam_screen.part_consolidation: three splayed tapered runners and two common flanges in one BREP

interpretation.flow: one-dimensional steady screen only; port pulsation, runner interaction, boundary layers, roughness and full plenum are absent
interpretation.acoustic: 100 mm quarter-wave result is not intake tuning because the complete runner, valve timing and reflection boundaries are absent
interpretation.mechanics: thin-wall pressure only; flange bending, bolt preload, vibration, fatigue and backfire are absent
interpretation.thermal: uniform delta-T screen only; head conduction, fuel film and transient heat soak are absent
interpretation.mass: no commercial mass is published, so the calculated pair mass cannot validate the concept
interpretation.physicsnemo: deferred until correlated CFD/CHT and structural cases with uncertainty and OOD gates exist
interpretation.simready: deferred until ports, bolt pattern, installed environment and qualified material card are measured

release_blockers: No measured PMO part, cylinder-head ports, throttle interface, spacings, bolt pattern, gaskets, clearances or tolerances.
The 46 x 42 x 100 mm string has no public drawing defining its datums or meaning.
No commercial mass, aluminium grade, heat treatment, process or wall distribution.
No measured M64 airflow, volumetric-efficiency map, valve timing, pressure pulses, temperature or acoustic boundary conditions.
No qualified LPBF material card, surface condition, leak criterion or fuel compatibility assessment.
No build orientation, supports, recoater check, machining stock or distortion compensation.
No transient compressible CFD, conjugate heat transfer, modal, fatigue or backfire load case.
No dimensional inspection, CT, pressure/leak bench, flow bench, thermal cycle, shaker or engine dyno test.
No professional engine engineering review or approved validation plan.
